integrity: The proof is exact and self-contained once the standard vertex-scaling definition and Euclidean barycentric construction are fixed. The key algebraic identity was independently simplified symbolically as a consistency check. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the standard Euclidean barycentric metric subdivision on one explicit one-parameter family of a single triangle. It does not rule out modified metric assignments on barycentric combinatorics or any other subdivision scheme, and it does not solve the general 2015 existence problem.
title: Barycentric subdivision is rigid along a one-vertex discrete-conformal ray
